title: FiGO expense policy limit not enforced - employees submitting above-limit amounts
description: The expense policy limit of 500 TL for meal expenses is not being enforced by FiGO. Employees are successfully submitting meal expense reports above 500 TL without any warning or rejection. The policy was configured in the FiGO policy management module 3 months ago.

worklogs.description: Checked FiGO expense policy configuration. The 500 TL limit is set for the 'Meal' category, but the enforcement action is set to 'Flag for review' not 'Block submission'.
Changed enforcement action from 'Flag for review' to 'Reject and notify' for amounts over the limit.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Hello, I found the issue. The 500 TL meal expense limit is configured correctly in the FiGO policy module, but the enforcement action when the limit is exceeded is set to 'Flag for review' rather than 'Block submission'. In 'Flag for review' mode, the expense goes through but is marked for the approver's attention. It does not actually prevent the submission. The stricter option is 'Reject and notify' which blocks the expense and tells the employee to split the receipt or seek approval for...

comments.author: customer
comments.message: It should be blocked. Employees should not be able to submit above 500 TL meal expenses without prior approval from their manager.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Understood. I have changed the enforcement action to 'Reject and notify' for the Meal expense category when the amount exceeds 500 TL. The rejection message will tell employees to either split the receipt or request a pre-approval exception. Existing submitted expenses above the limit that are already pending approval are not affected by this change - those will continue through the normal approval flow. New submissions from today will be enforced. Please test by trying to submit a meal...

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Tested - the 600 TL test expense was blocked with the message you described. This is exactly what we needed. Thank you.

resolutionNote: Expense policy enforcement action was set to 'Flag for review' instead of 'Reject and notify'. Changed to 'Reject and notify' for Meal category amounts exceeding 500 TL.
